text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the spending time with me today. I feel refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I have something planned after this, so I must take my leave.
Hey, heeey!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's five minutes and ten seconds before our designated meeting time. It's unlike you to be early, Jordan.
choice_data_list: Oh, so you had plans with Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well, we planned to meet, anyway. As for our plans, however…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have yet to hear exactly what it is we're doing today, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For reals? Meh, we're just gonna wing it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wing it?! But we planned this outing nearly one month ago!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All right, okay. Don't have a cow! How about we go to karaoke for starters?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What a noncommittal suggestion… Listen, systematically mapping out plans is an important part of—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Boo to plans! Going on vibes won't kill you for just one day! Besides, spur-of-the-moment karaoke is like, part of Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course! Everyone knows that. Anyway, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, you should come with us too! The more the merrier!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whew, I really sang my heart out. 'Kay, Flash, you're up.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I was contemplating the Japanese custom of "going to karaoke for starters"…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Are you serious? Lol! It's not that big a deal, is it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Before coming here as an exchange student, I thoroughly studied recent trends in Japanese culture… At least, I thought I had.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It appears Japan is progressing at a pace beyond my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: How will I be able to keep up with a Japan that keeps evolving at such a mind-boggling speed?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …D-dang. You're, like… really down about this. Uh… What to do?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! Everyone learns about trends through exposure!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In summary, experience is the best teacher, and constant interaction with the latest elements of Japanese culture is paramount…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In that case, I must sing the top-ranking J-pop song. What is this? "Ramp"… "Ramp Up Love"!
choice_data_list: It's okay to stick with songs you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash starts singing the trendy J-pop song, but…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "I'm lost in love! ♪" Ack, my rhythm is lagging 0.5 seconds behind the melody once again…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "My heart is full of you! ♪" C'mon, Flash. Live it up!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! "Together, we rise! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So? Whaddya think of your first "unplanned karaoke"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well… I think I better understand why it is part of Japanese culture now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Getting on more casual terms with music makes it easier to understand the culture it hails from.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phew! I totally made that up on the spot, so I was, like, on edge the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You… did what?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gah! That's not what I meant! Karaoke is all about the vibes, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's a part of the culture… Or maybe… it's, like, my culture…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan gets a thorough scolding from Eishin Flash after that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: True that! Singing something you know and love is loads better than forcing yourself to sing something random!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Would a German children's song be acceptable, then? I am only really familiar with nursery rhymes, to be frank.
choice_data_list: I'm not sure the machine has any…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: German nursery rhymes are often sung in Japan, so I would assume so.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The frog-based "Kaeru no Uta" is the most famous example.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, that song's originally German? Like, no cap? Even I know that one.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ooh, why don't we sing as a duet in German and Japanese?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You would? In that case, let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So? Whaddya think of your first "unplanned karaoke"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well, it made me realize that I must constantly try to stay abreast of new trends.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And if I had to summarize it in one word…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It would be "fun."
